app.name: Evolution Golf Draft Assistant
app.short_description: Drafts a reply in the team's voice, grounded in past tickets and the live order.
app.long_description: Generates a suggested reply for the open ticket using Evolution Golf's own settled policy, the way the team has answered similar tickets before, and the live Shopify order. Nothing is sent: the draft is inserted into the reply box for an agent to check, edit and send.
app.installation_instructions: Set the service URL to the drafting service on Railway, and paste the admin token. The token is stored as a secure setting, so it is never visible in the browser.

service_url.label: Service URL
service_url.helpText: The drafting service base URL, e.g. https://support-drafting.up.railway.app

admin_token.label: Admin token
admin_token.helpText: The ADMIN_TOKEN set on the drafting service. Stored securely and substituted outside the browser.
